passed_items: TypeScript 5.4+ strict and decorators (tsconfig strict: true, experimentalDecorators)
Order aggregate with OrderId, status, items, totalAmount
Money value object (immutable, decimal via number rounding)
Empty order invariant (at least one item)
State transitions: CANCELLED from PENDING|PAID; SHIPPED from PAID
Domain exceptions: DomainException, InvalidOrderStateException, InvalidItemException, CurrencyMismatchException, OrderNotFoundException
Database: orders and order_items tables (TypeORM entities), UUID PK, FK, indexes on customer_id and status
TypeORM entities separate from domain; mappers Domain <-> TypeORM
Transactions at application level (DataSource.transaction in repository)
Persistence adapter implementing output port (OrderRepository -> IOrderRepository)
POST /orders, GET /orders/:orderId, POST /orders/:orderId/pay under API prefix
class-validator on DTOs (IsUUID, IsPositive, Min, ValidateNested, ArrayMinSize)
Unit tests for domain (order.spec, order-item.spec, money.spec, address.spec)
Service tests for application (create-order, get-order, pay-order .spec)
failed_items: ESLint + Prettier: packages in devDependencies but no .eslintrc* or .prettierrc* or eslintConfig in package.json — code style enforcement not configured
Lock file: no package-lock.json or pnpm-lock.yaml found — build reproducibility not enforced
Jest coverageThreshold (80% minimum) not configured in package.json or jest config
Integration/e2e: test/e2e structure and jest-e2e.json referenced in script but test/ directory missing — test:e2e script broken
Global ExceptionFilter: DomainExceptionFilter is applied per-controller (@UseFilters on OrdersController), not via app.useGlobalFilters() — may be acceptable if single API surface
